name: Being Friends With Non Christians
overview: Scripture calls believers to engage with non-Christians not as allies in neutrality but as those who must actively warn and seek their repentance, recognizing that those who reject the gospel remain in spiritual death (Ezekiel 33:9; Mark 16:16). Jesus' command to preach the gospel to all underscores the responsibility to reach every person with the message of salvation (Mark 16:15), while also making clear that neutrality is impossible—one is either with Christ or against Him (Matthew 12:30). The heart's natural enmity toward God (Romans 8:7) highlights the need for gospel outreach, as Christ came to call sinners to repentance, not the self-righteous (Luke 5:32).
